summary: Aviation Workforce Development Act This bill expands the qualified higher education expenses that may be paid for with tax-free distributions from a qualified tuition program (also known as a 529 plan) to include expenses (e.g., tuition, fees, books, supplies, and equipment) for aviation maintenance or commercial pilot courses taught at schools certified by the Federal Aviation Administration. Under current law, 529 plan distributions are excluded from gross income, for federal tax purposes, if they are used to pay for qualified higher education expenses.
